meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本变成配图解的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想不露脸就把文字稿变成解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video with generated graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos without filming anything.

howto.what: 把一段文章、笔记或主题交给Claude，它会做成一部无脸解说视频：不拍实景，每帧画面（排版、图形、图表等）现设计；过程中依次产出故事板、脚本、音频信息和逐帧画面，最终合成MP4。
howto.when: 当你给出一段文字（文章、笔记等）并要求做成主题解说、概念讲解、教程等无脸视频时触发；不做网站演示或实拍视频。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成无脸解说视频。
say.note: Claude会先产出故事板，再逐帧生成，最后合成视频。

say.text: 把这几个步骤做成一条清单式教程视频。
say.note: 适合how-to类内容，视觉会按文字内容现造。

say.text: 用抽象图表把这个概念讲给新手听。
say.note: 它会走概念分解的讲解结构来规划。

howto.what_en: Give Claude any text and it becomes a faceless explainer video: no filming, per-scene visuals (typography, charts, diagrams) are invented, and the run yields a storyboard, script, audio metadata, frames and a final MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you supply source text and ask for a faceless explainer video (topic explainer, concept breakdown, how-to, etc.) with nothing to capture from a real site or footage. Unclear intents fall back to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: It drafts a storyboard, builds frames, then renders.

say_en.text: Make a listicle tutorial video from these steps.
say_en.note: Good for how-to content; visuals are invented, not filmed.

say_en.text: Explain this concept to beginners with abstract charts.
say_en.note: It uses a concept-breakdown structure and animates it.
